newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen moving higher in thin trading.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen moving higher in thin trading.

text.p: With little news expected and many leading overseas markets closed, the "Santa Claus" rally is expected to continue for U.S. stocks on Thursday in thin trading as investors return after the Christmas holiday, share analysts said.
"I don't think there will be any major announcements and the bias is to move higher in the latter part of December," said Prudential Securities' Larry Wachtel.

The Dow Jones industrial average rose 33.83 on Tuesday to 6,522.85, nearing its record closing high of 6,547.79 and outpacing the broader market as investors sought the safety and liquidity of blue chips.
